name: Item Editor Test
description: GUI test of the item editor in rpg_plus: opens rpg_plus_game's items, shows a demo item's localized name, adds an item with the New button, types its name, price and a type into the form, copies it and undoes the copy with Ctrl+Z, saves; the game must know the item and its name at once and the other item files stay unchanged. Equip is a picker of the equip types; the resin item is renamed through the Rename dialog (the preview lists the recipe, shop and scenario files), the game knows the new id, and Undo restores every file of the mod byte for byte. The new file and the locale edits are removed again. Activated by --itest=items_editor_edit with --game=rpg_plus --new (the prologue is clicked through first).
